title: 梯度累加随机舍入（未接线 reserve）

standard.summary: 当前训练 loop 只拿到已经量化的 BF16/FP16 grad，没有舍入前 FP32 source；启用会 fail-fast。
standard.effect: 不再对已量化 grad 做无效的二次舍入，也不再宣称能恢复小于一个 ULP 的梯度残差。
standard.whenToUse: 当前不要启用；待累加 seam 显式提供 FP32 gradient source 后再开放。
standard.avoidWhen: 所有现有通用训练路径；使用 FP32 梯度累加或 optimizer-owned master gradient 方案。

standard_en.summary: The current training loop only receives gradients already quantized to BF16/FP16, with no pre-rounding FP32 source; enabling this fails fast.
standard_en.effect: It no longer performs a pointless second rounding of already-quantized gradients, and no longer claims to recover gradient residue smaller than one ULP.
standard_en.whenToUse: Do not enable it for now; it will open up once the accumulation seam explicitly provides an FP32 gradient source.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Every existing general training path; use FP32 gradient accumulation or an optimizer-owned master-gradient scheme instead.

advanced.principle: 随机舍入必须在 FP32 精确梯度转换到低精度的边界执行。当前 hook 位于低精度 grad 已形成之后，原始残差不可恢复。
advanced.intervention: TrainingLoop builder 对 stochastic_grad_accumulation=True 返回 STOCHASTIC_GRAD_ACCUMULATION_FP32_SOURCE_REQUIRED。
advanced.expectedImpact: 当前没有收益声明；该字段仅保留旧配置可读性。
advanced.tradeoffs: 启用即拒绝，避免静默 no-op。

advanced_en.principle: Stochastic rounding must be applied at the boundary where exact FP32 gradients convert to lower precision. The current hook sits after the low-precision grad has already formed, so the original residual is unrecoverable.
advanced_en.intervention: The TrainingLoop builder returns STOCHASTIC_GRAD_ACCUMULATION_FP32_SOURCE_REQUIRED for stochastic_grad_accumulation=True.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No benefit claimed currently; the field is kept only so old configs stay readable.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Enabling it is rejected outright, avoiding a silent no-op.
